SourceFinding.Description: SapDiApiBusyException is rethrown without MarkFailureAsync; controller returns HTTP 503. This path can leave NEW/RetryCount=0/ErrorMessage=NULL after a request has already ended.

RetryCountMeaning: MarkFailureAsync increments this value; it is not a complete count of incoming requests or evidence of automatic retries.
